focus: Canonicalize the three work-RAM VDP tile-row command tables built during video initialization and consumed by tile rendering/camera refill paths.
contracts: VDP_BuildTileRowCommandTables writes 32 longword commands to each of 0x00FF8680, 0x00FF8700, and 0x00FF8780.
The selected table and its mirror receive identical commands; the alternate table receives the other C000/E000 plane sequence.
VDP_TILE_PLANE_ORDER selects which plane base is represented by the selected versus alternate tables.
conclusion: The three anonymous work-RAM regions are the selected, selected-mirror, and alternate VDP tile-row command tables.
